summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for the borough of the Wirral (“the Borough”) following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. The area of the Borough remains unchanged.

summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for Somerset following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. This Order does not change the boundary of the local authority itself.

summary: This Order updates the list of public bodies in schedule 1 of the Climate Change (Duties of Public Bodies: Reporting Requirements) (Scotland) Order 2015.
